interpretation: This first bounded full-resolution comparison reproduces all 93 originally captured simplified-product contacts: 72 ISR and 21 SAU. The 90 same-full-JOR-member contacts and the 3 JOR full-member-miss contacts are all full-product exact-feature hits at their original native cell centers too. It therefore does not clear or reduce those adverse contacts; the historical 0/93 claim remains contradicted and its cause is not explained by this comparison.
limitations: Full-resolution comparator is separate from the originally consumed simplified source role and does not substitute for it.
The actual comparison found exact original-feature hits for all 93 keys in the full and simplified products; this does not clear a contact or change its held status.
This comparison does not establish jurisdiction, source authority, or current legal status.
Contact keys represent exact native cell centers; center predicates are not whole-cell clearance.
The previously retained 0/93 artifact remains contradicted historical evidence; this comparison does not establish its cause.

method.per_feature_application: Each of the 6 ISR and 13 SAU features was independently converted by the accepted nativeRuntimeIndex and evaluated through nativePolygonIntervals over the exact contact-row span; this preserves multiple sibling hits rather than allowing cross-feature first-owner masking. The per-key arrays map results back to immutable original gb:*:ADM1:<shapeID> identifiers.
